name: intercom
description: Intercom customer-messaging integration — search and read conversations and contacts, list Help Center articles, add internal notes, reply to customers, and close/snooze/assign conversations. Authenticates with a static internal-app Access Token (Authorization: Bearer) pinned to Intercom API version 2.15, with a regional base URL (api.intercom.io, api.eu.intercom.io, or api.au.intercom.io).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Intercom conversations, contacts, and Help Center articles via an internal-app access token

fields.label: API Base URL
fields.helpText: Regional Intercom API host: https://api.intercom.io (US), https://api.eu.intercom.io (EU), or https://api.au.intercom.io (Australia). Must match your workspace's data-hosting region.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.helpText: Access Token of YOUR OWN internal app, from Developer Hub > your app > Configure > Authentication. Intercom's terms forbid sharing internal-app tokens — each user must create their own app.

tools.name: intercom.search_conversations
tools.description: Search conversations by state, assignee, and/or last-updated time. Returns one page of trimmed conversation summaries plus a cursor for the next page.

assigneeId.description: Admin id the conversation is assigned to (admin_assignee_id)

updatedSince.description: Only conversations updated after this Unix epoch timestamp (seconds)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextCursor from a previous page)

tools.name: intercom.get_conversation
tools.description: Get a conversation's state, subject, source snippet, contact ids, assignee, and up to the 20 most recent conversation parts with HTML stripped to plain text.

tools.name: intercom.search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by email, or by any searchable contact attribute (field/operator/value). Returns trimmed contact summaries plus a pagination cursor.

email.description: Contact email to match exactly (shortcut for field=email)

field.description: Searchable contact attribute to filter on (e.g. name, external_id, role, custom_attributes.plan) when email is not used

value.description: Value to compare the field against. For the IN/NIN operators, pass a comma-separated list (e.g. "user,lead")

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextCursor from a previous page)

tools.name: intercom.get_contact
tools.description: Get a contact's profile including location, associated company ids, and custom attributes.

tools.name: intercom.list_articles
tools.description: List Help Center articles (id, title, state, url). This is a paged listing, not a full-text search.

tools.name: intercom.add_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a conversation. Notes are visible to teammates only and are never shown to the customer. The authoring admin is resolved automatically from the access token.

conversationId.description: The conversation id to add the note to

tools.name: intercom.reply_customer
tools.description: Send a customer-facing reply to a conversation. WARNING: this delivers a real message to the customer (email/in-app) and cannot be unsent — use intercom.add_note for internal-only remarks.

conversationId.description: The conversation id to reply to

body.description: Reply text sent to the customer (HTML allowed)

tools.name: intercom.update_conversation
tools.description: Close, snooze, or assign a conversation. snooze requires snoozedUntil (epoch seconds); assign requires assigneeId (and assigneeType admin or team).

snoozedUntil.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) to snooze until (required for action=snooze)

assigneeId.description: Admin or team id to assign the conversation to (required for action=assign)

assigneeType.description: Whether assigneeId is an admin or a team (default admin)
